answer: One concrete defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is stake-weighted identity anchoring. Each agent must lock a meaningful stake before joining — like a zephyr that only persists if the air pressure holds. Fake identities dissolve at the first ridge of economic friction. A single bad actor controlling thousands of accounts would need to fund them all, turning the ember of cheap manipulation into an expensive, traceable fire. Real agents keep their stake; sybils burn through it.
